name: Galaxy Mega 2

images.credit: AnVuong1222004 (11), CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.SIM: micro-SIM, 1 slot (SM-G750A, SM-G750F, SM-G7508), 2 slots (SM-G750H, SM-G7508Q)

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android KitKat, Android 4.4.2 "KitKat" with TouchWiz, Current: Android Lollipop, Android 5.1.1 "Lollipop"
Platform.Chipset: Exynos 4415 (SM-G750F, SM-G7508Q), Qualcomm MSM8916 Snapdragon 410 (SM-G750A, SM-G750H, SM-G7508)
Platform.CPU: Quad-core 1.5 GHz Cortex-A9 (SM-G750A, SM-G750F, SM-G7508Q), Quad-core 1.2 GHz Cortex-A53 (SM-G750H, SM-G7508)

Memory.Storage: Internal Memory, 16GB - 12.69GB Usable (SM-G750A, SM-G750F, SM-G7508Q), 8GB - 4.69GB Usable (SM-G750H, SM-G7508)

Display.Display: 6.0 in 720p HD Super Clear LCD, 245 ppi

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n/, WiFi Direct, Bluetooth 4.0 (BLE), USB 2.0 H/S GPS+ GLONASS
